additional_metadata_and_score_types.limits: Only the additional boolean tensor payload; excludes Python object metadata and CPU/CUDA allocation rounding. No speed improvement claimed for reflection-correctness changes.

limits: Before/fix stages are separated; 250427 is not a validation of the later GLY implementation.

The full-atom matrix check uses the exact 6dmz_mod L/D fixture pair with no hydrogen optimization, default repacking choices, symmetric GLY model, and 0.98 library coverage. Equivalent H may permute only with identical types and named neighbors.
24 beta2016 score components are compared, including zero components for chemistry absent from this canonical fixture; this does not independently cover every chemical class in every component.

Expanded-chi counts/heavy geometry, all-grid native probabilities/means and per-library terminal defaults have separate checks. Full expanded all-atom interaction matrices are not exhaustively enumerated.

Actual CUDA packing uses a single movable PHE, compares with exhaustive whole-pose scores over every offered state, and checks reflected final coordinates. This is not a guarantee of identical stochastic multi-position trajectories.

Optional GLY symmetrization averages two ideal C-H lengths and their harmonic targets/force constants. Default chemical/scoring YAML files are unchanged; this is an explicit model variant, not an independent parameter refit.

No performance improvement is claimed for these correctness fixes. Additional reflection tensor payload is 36 bytes; allocator rounding, Python metadata and restored missing conformers are outside that number.
Non-grid-aligned custom registrations, empty library families and name-based mirrored-library generation remain separate audit items.
